skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
A set of Tianshi clothes Leizi picked out as a disguise for Blaze during their time in Baizao.
While she no longer has to worry about any issues with her identity, she still wears this lightweight and convenient outfit quite often.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She has finished her exploration into her past.
From now on, she is only a Rhodes Island elite operator.

skins.name: Homecoming Night
skins.content: Cambrian 1102 Winter New Arrivals/Homecoming Night. Made from multiple layers of multifunctional materials. A light down coat to keep warm, a silver coating to ward off rain and wear. Perfect for both lounging at home and riding a steed of steel.
skins.usage: One of Blaze the Igniting Spark's casual outfits.
skins.quote: The Feline woman rushes home. There is someone waiting to cook with her back at their warm, candlelit home, after all. This time, she wants to be around for prepping the dumpling skins.
